ThingDef.label: wraith gravcore seed
ThingDef.description: A dense workshop-grown organ seed carrying a gravitic developmental pattern. Implant it into a living biological prisoner or slave, or into a biological humanlike corpse. The seed is committed immediately. A living host is consumed after one day of gestation; a corpse is consumed immediately into an incubating mass. Either route produces a functional gravcore after one day.

li.commandDescription: Implant this seed into a living biological prisoner or slave, or a biological humanlike corpse. After one day, a gravcore emerges.

ThingDef.label: incubating living forge mass
ThingDef.description: A biological corpse consumed by Wraith host-seed tissue. Keep the mass spawned on the map while it converts; after one day it becomes a minified living forge.

li.completionMessage: The corpse-incubated living forge has finished growing.

ThingDef.label: incubating gravcore mass
ThingDef.description: A biological humanlike corpse consumed by a Wraith gravcore seed. Keep the mass spawned on the map while it converts; after one day it becomes a functional gravcore.

li.completionMessage: The corpse-incubated Wraith gravcore has finished growing.
